query:
-- Lição 390001: Hello World
UPDATE lessons SET vocabularyDetailed = '[
  {"word":"hello","translation":"olá","phonetic":"/həˈloʊ/","example":"Hello! How are you?","synonyms":["hi","greetings","hey"]},
  {"word":"world","translation":"mundo","phonetic":"/wɜːrld/","example":"Welcome to the world of English!","synonyms":["earth","globe","planet"]},
  {"word":"name","translation":"nome","phonetic":"/neɪm/","example":"My name is Lucy.","synonyms":["title","label","designation"]},
  {"word":"friend","translation":"amigo","phonetic":"/frɛnd/","example":"This is my friend Tom.","synonyms":["buddy","pal","companion"]},
  {"word":"happy","translation":"feliz","phonetic":"/ˈhæpi/","example":"I am happy to meet you!","synonyms":["joyful","glad","cheerful"]},
  {"word":"meet","translation":"conhecer","phonetic":"/miːt/","example":"Nice to meet you!","synonyms":["encounter","greet","see"]},
  {"word":"nice","translation":"legal","phonetic":"/naɪs/","example":"It is a nice day today.","synonyms":["pleasant","good","lovely"]},
  {"word":"day","translation":"dia","phonetic":"/deɪ/","example":"Have a great day!","synonyms":["daytime","date","period"]}
]' WHERE id = 390001;

-- Lição 390002: My Family
UPDATE lessons SET vocabularyDetailed = '[
  {"word":"family","translation":"família","phonetic":"/ˈfæməli/","example":"I love my family very much.","synonyms":["relatives","kin","household"]},
  {"word":"mother","translation":"mãe","phonetic":"/ˈmʌðər/","example":"My mother is very kind.","synonyms":["mom","mama","mum"]},
  {"word":"father","translation":"pai","phonetic":"/ˈfɑːðər/","example":"My father works hard.","synonyms":["dad","papa","pop"]},
  {"word":"sister","translation":"irmã","phonetic":"/ˈsɪstər/","example":"My sister is younger than me.","synonyms":["sibling","sis"]},
  {"word":"brother","translation":"irmão","phonetic":"/ˈbrʌðər/","example":"My brother plays soccer.","synonyms":["sibling","bro"]},
  {"word":"love","translation":"amor","phonetic":"/lʌv/","example":"We love each other.","synonyms":["affection","care","adore"]},
  {"word":"home","translation":"casa","phonetic":"/hoʊm/","example":"Home is where the heart is.","synonyms":["house","residence","dwelling"]},
  {"word":"together","translation":"juntos","phonetic":"/təˈɡɛðər/","example":"We eat dinner together.","synonyms":["jointly","collectively","united"]}
]' WHERE id = 390002;

-- Lição 390004: At the Restaurant
UPDATE lessons SET vocabularyDetailed = '[
  {"word":"restaurant","translation":"restaurante","phonetic":"/ˈrɛstərɑːnt/","example":"We are eating at a restaurant.","synonyms":["cafe","diner","eatery"]},
  {"word":"menu","translation":"cardápio","phonetic":"/ˈmɛnjuː/","example":"Can I see the menu, please?","synonyms":["list","carte","bill of fare"]},
  {"word":"order","translation":"pedir","phonetic":"/ˈɔːrdər/","example":"I would like to order pasta.","synonyms":["request","ask for","command"]},
  {"word":"waiter","translation":"garçom","phonetic":"/ˈweɪtər/","example":"The waiter is very polite.","synonyms":["server","attendant","steward"]},
  {"word":"food","translation":"comida","phonetic":"/fuːd/","example":"The food here is delicious!","synonyms":["meal","dish","cuisine"]},
  {"word":"drink","translation":"bebida","phonetic":"/drɪŋk/","example":"What would you like to drink?","synonyms":["beverage","liquid refreshment"]},
  {"word":"delicious","translation":"delicioso","phonetic":"/dɪˈlɪʃəs/","example":"This pizza is delicious!","synonyms":["tasty","yummy","scrumptious"]},
  {"word":"bill","translation":"conta","phonetic":"/bɪl/","example":"Can we have the bill, please?","synonyms":["check","tab","invoice"]}
]' WHERE id = 390004;

-- Lição 390005: School Life
UPDATE lessons SET vocabularyDetailed = '[
  {"word":"school","translation":"escola","phonetic":"/skuːl/","example":"I go to school every day.","synonyms":["academy","institution","college"]},
  {"word":"teacher","translation":"professor","phonetic":"/ˈtiːtʃər/","example":"My teacher is very helpful.","synonyms":["instructor","educator","tutor"]},
  {"word":"student","translation":"estudante","phonetic":"/ˈstuːdənt/","example":"She is a good student.","synonyms":["pupil","learner","scholar"]},
  {"word":"book","translation":"livro","phonetic":"/bʊk/","example":"I am reading an interesting book.","synonyms":["volume","text","publication"]},
  {"word":"homework","translation":"dever de casa","phonetic":"/ˈhoʊmwɜːrk/","example":"I need to finish my homework.","synonyms":["assignment","schoolwork","task"]},
  {"word":"learn","translation":"aprender","phonetic":"/lɜːrn/","example":"We learn new things every day.","synonyms":["study","acquire","master"]},
  {"word":"class","translation":"aula","phonetic":"/klæs/","example":"Math class starts at 9 AM.","synonyms":["lesson","course","period"]},
  {"word":"exam","translation":"prova","phonetic":"/ɪɡˈzæm/","example":"The exam is next week.","synonyms":["test","quiz","assessment"]}
]' WHERE id = 390005;

-- Lição 390006: Business Meeting
UPDATE lessons SET vocabularyDetailed = '[
  {"word":"meeting","translation":"reunião","phonetic":"/ˈmiːtɪŋ/","example":"We have a meeting at 10 AM.","synonyms":["conference","assembly","gathering"]},
  {"word":"presentation","translation":"apresentação","phonetic":"/ˌprɛzənˈteɪʃən/","example":"Her presentation was excellent.","synonyms":["talk","speech","demonstration"]},
  {"word":"agenda","translation":"pauta","phonetic":"/əˈdʒɛndə/","example":"What is on the agenda today?","synonyms":["schedule","plan","program"]},
  {"word":"deadline","translation":"prazo","phonetic":"/ˈdɛdlaɪn/","example":"The deadline is Friday.","synonyms":["due date","time limit","cutoff"]},
  {"word":"project","translation":"projeto","phonetic":"/ˈprɑːdʒɛkt/","example":"Our project is almost complete.","synonyms":["plan","scheme","undertaking"]},
  {"word":"client","translation":"cliente","phonetic":"/ˈklaɪənt/","example":"The client is very satisfied.","synonyms":["customer","patron","buyer"]},
  {"word":"proposal","translation":"proposta","phonetic":"/prəˈpoʊzəl/","example":"We need to review the proposal.","synonyms":["offer","suggestion","plan"]},
  {"word":"contract","translation":"contrato","phonetic":"/ˈkɑːntrækt/","example":"Please sign the contract.","synonyms":["agreement","deal","pact"]}
]' WHERE id = 390006;
